messages:
rishi_malhotra: seeing multiple tickets reporting OpenAI-compat streaming hanging in us-east. anyone else seeing?
incident-bot: Created incident INC-2025-0328-stream-hang (sev1).
david_kim: yup, open_streams is climbing and tokens_out is flat. looks like events not flushing.
ava_chen: customers say they get headers + maybe first chunk then nothing until their client times out.
maya_srinivasan: did we roll edge config today? buffering/compression could be biting SSE.
david_kim: edge rollout started 09:50 UTC. going to rollback in us-east now.
rishi_malhotra: pls post when rollback complete so we can update customers
david_kim: rollback done. seeing immediate recovery in canary.
maya_srinivasan: i'll open a PR to hard-disable buffering/compression on SSE routes for oai-compat.
rishi_malhotra: thanks. will link SUP-3091 + follow up in thread
